title: Lesson 1: Drive Straight
steps: 👋 Welcome to your first XRP lesson! In this lesson, you'll make the XRP robot drive straight forward.
Look at the toolbox on the left. You'll see a Drive category — click it to open it.
A Drive Straight block has already been added for you! The distance is set to 20 cm.
The block has a distance input. Try changing it to a different distance — how far do you want to go?
🎉 Great job! Connect your XRP robot and press Run to see it drive straight. Well done!
